title: A Wall tile decision that fails leaves no trace
body:
## Summary
A / S / C / B on a focused Wall tile runs useDecide() outside the Gate, and WallVariant never rendered decide.isError: a failed decision was silent.

## Description
apps/studio/src/board/WallVariant.tsx:105 decides from the tile; every other decide/undo/restore consumer (shared.tsx Gate, RejectedLane, CasesView, ArchivedView, StylesView) renders its .isError. Fixed: the wall bar shows 'Not recorded: <server error>' (role=alert) at apps/studio/src/board/WallVariant.tsx:175. Technique: async-ui-states/failure-states.

## Flow
- focus a tile, press S while the server refuses (archived item 409, server down)
- before: nothing changes, no message
- after: the wall bar says Not recorded: <reason>

## Expected impact
The owner triaging from the keyboard learns a decision did not land. Could break: nothing; one more alert line in the bar.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - every Board mutation failure is visible
Before: 9 of 10 mutation consumers render their failure (WallVariant decide silent)
After: 10 of 10
Method: gate - surfaces.test.ts 'board mutations' seeded red on HEAD with the one silent consumer, green after
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence:
apps/studio/src/board/surfaces.test.ts:18 (gate)
red on HEAD: ["WallVariant.tsx: decide = useDecide()"]
apps/studio/src/board/WallVariant.tsx:175

title: A held key decides one use case idea after the next
body:
## Summary
The idea dialog's A/N/S/I/D/U handler did not ignore auto-repeat, unlike the Gate and the Wall tile.

## Description
apps/studio/src/board/CasesView.tsx onKey checked modifiers but not e.repeat; on success the dialog advances (nextUndecided), so the next repeat keydown decided the following idea. The Gate (shared.tsx) and Wall tile (WallVariant.tsx) guarded e.repeat by hand. Fixed: one helper apps/studio/src/board/keys.ts:26 plainPress(e) used by all three (CasesView.tsx:416, shared.tsx:548, WallVariant.tsx:105).

## Flow
- open an idea, hold N past the OS repeat delay (~500 ms)
- before: idea 1 rejected, dialog advances, repeats reject idea 2, 3...
- after: one idea rejected per press

## Expected impact
Prevents silent mass rejection of ideas. Could break: nothing; a held key now does nothing after the first press.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - one decision per key press everywhere
Before: 2 of 3 decision-key handlers guard e.repeat
After: 3 of 3, through one helper
Method: gate - keys.test.ts plainPress cases + surfaces.test.ts 'decision keys' (seeded red: all three files lacked plainPress, CasesView lacked any repeat guard)
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence:
git grep -n 'repeat' apps/studio/src/board/*.tsx (HEAD 2cbb43b): shared.tsx Gate e.repeat, WallVariant.tsx e.repeat, CasesView.tsx none
apps/studio/src/board/keys.ts:26

title: Log drawer polls a finished job's log every 2 s forever
body:
## Summary
LogDrawer said it stops once the job is over and the log read to its end; the loop re-armed its timer unconditionally.

## Description
apps/studio/src/board/LogDrawer.tsx header vs its loop (HEAD): `if (!stop) timer = setTimeout(pull, 2000)` with no end condition. Fixed: loop moved to apps/studio/src/board/logtail.ts:13 tailLog; a read that comes back empty while the job is not queued/running ends it (logtail.ts:35).

## Flow
- open View log on a done/failed job and leave the drawer open
- before: GET /log every 2 s
- after: 3 reads then none

## Expected impact
Fewer pointless requests and server file reads. Could break: a job that writes after it is marked done would not be tailed (status sampled before each read covers the last chunk).

## Evaluation
Claim: performance - no polling once nothing can change
Before: 31 GET /log in 60 s for a finished job (fake timers, old loop)
After: 3 then 0
Method: gate - logtail.test.ts seeded red with the old loop (31 calls), green after
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence:
logtail.test.ts 'stops once the job is over': AssertionError expected spy 3 times, got 31 (old loop)
apps/studio/src/board/logtail.ts:35

title: Log read failures render as 'No log lines yet.'
body:
## Summary
The drawer's read loop swallowed every error, so a 404 / 500 / server down showed the same empty log as a silent job.

## Description
Empty catch ('the next tick retries') in the log loop. Fixed: tailLog onError reports each failure and clears on the next good read; LogDrawer shows 'Could not read the log: <error>. Retrying every 2 s.' (apps/studio/src/board/LogDrawer.tsx:103). Technique: async-ui-states/failure-states.

## Flow
- open the log of a job whose log file is gone (404)
- before: No log lines yet.
- after: the alert with the error

## Expected impact
The owner knows the log is unreadable rather than empty. Could break: nothing.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - a failure is not an empty log
Before: 0 of 3 failure kinds distinguishable from an empty log
After: 3 of 3
Method: gate - logtail.test.ts failure case red before (onError never called)
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence:
apps/studio/src/board/LogDrawer.tsx (HEAD) catch { /* the next tick retries */ }
apps/studio/src/board/LogDrawer.tsx:103

title: Undo toast offers undos that already happened elsewhere
body:
## Summary
Only the toast pruned the undo stack; undos from the Gate, Rejected lane or idea dialog left stale entries, and re-decided rows kept two.

## Description
useUndoDecision / useUndoCase never told the store. Fixed: entries carry a row key (board:<id> / case:<id>), a newer decision replaces the row's entry, forget(key) on outside undo (apps/studio/src/board/undo-store.ts:140). Technique: undo-history/undo-scope + stack-policy.

## Flow
- reject X, then press Undo in the lightbox Gate
- before: toast still offers Undo; Z DELETEs a pending item and says 'Undone: Rejected · style · X'
- after: the entry is gone

## Expected impact
The toast and Z only promise what they will do. Could break: restore toasts stay unkeyed by design.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - the stack mirrors the rows
Before: walked on the store: 1 stale entry per outside undo; 3 entries for 2 rows after a re-decide
After: 0 stale; 1 entry per row
Method: gate - undo-store.test.ts 'one decision per row' red on HEAD
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence:
apps/studio/src/board/shared.tsx useUndoDecision onSuccess (HEAD): invalidate only
apps/server/src/board.ts undoDecision on a pending item succeeds silently

title: Light table progress meter never moves under the default Pending filter
body:
## Summary
The light table's '<decided> of <n> decided' counts the items it receives; under the default Pending filter those are only pending items, so it reads '0 of N decided' forever.

## Description
apps/studio/src/board/LightTableVariant.tsx:31 decided = items.filter(not pending); apps/studio/src/board/BoardPage.tsx:123 items = visibleItems(filterItems(all, filter)) - with st=pending every decided shot leaves the list. The meter is the variant's main progress cue (board-triage-first made Pending the default). Fix: a pure board.ts helper triageProgress(all, filter) counting the axis-filtered population regardless of status, passed through VariantProps.

## Flow
- open /board?v=2 (Pending default), decide three shots
- observed: '0 of N decided · N pending', N shrinking
- fix steps: helper + test, VariantProps.progress, LightTable reads it

## Expected impact
The owner sees real progress through a loop. Could break: tick meter semantics change (decided ticks for shots no longer listed).

## Evaluation
Claim: user - progress reflects decisions made
Before: 0 decided shown under Pending regardless of decisions (by reading the code path)
After: predicted: decided count grows per decision
Method: simulation - three walked cases (fresh loop, after 3 decisions, all decided); no DOM test env to drive the variant
Result: better
Gate: none
instrument: board.test.ts triageProgress cases (0 of N -> k of N after k decisions under st=pending) + an SSR render of LightTableVariant reading the meter

title: Style note editor closes before the save lands; a failed save loses the draft
body:
## Summary
StyleCard's note form calls send({ note }) and setEditing(false) synchronously; on failure the editor is gone and 'Edit note' resets the draft to the stored note.

## Description
apps/studio/src/board/StylesView.tsx:196 setEditing(false) right after patch.mutate; the error renders but the typed text is discarded when the owner reopens the editor (setNote(style.owner_note)). Lock/Retire/Restore buttons also have no pending guard (double sends). Technique: draft-editing (commit closes the draft only on success).

## Flow
- edit a style note with the server down, Save
- observed: editor closes, error line shows, Edit note shows the old note
- fix: close on onSuccess, keep the draft and the form on error; disable actions while patch.isPending

## Expected impact
No lost owner notes. Could break: nothing.

## Evaluation
Claim: user - a failed save keeps the draft
Before: 1 of 1 failure paths discards the draft (walked)
After: predicted 0
Method: simulation - needs a DOM interaction (node-only vitest, no happy-dom)
Result: better
Gate: none
instrument: a DOM test env (happy-dom) for StyleCard submit-with-rejected-mutation, or an e2e step with a 500 route

title: Matrix drawer re-opens on its own after an undo
body:
## Summary
When the open shot leaves the Matrix with no neighbour, `open` keeps the vanished id: the drawer disappears without returning focus, and a later undo brings the item back and pops the drawer open again.

## Description
apps/studio/src/board/MatrixVariant.tsx:53 openItem = order.find(open) ?? null (the Wall falls back to `all` and says 'Decided · no longer in this list'); useAdvanceOnRemoval (shared.tsx:506) only moves when a neighbour exists. Fix: clear `open` and focus the grid when the item leaves with no neighbour, or keep it visible as the Wall does.

## Flow
- Matrix, Pending filter, open the last pending shot, press S
- observed: drawer vanishes, focus on body
- press Z: the shot returns and the drawer reopens unasked

## Expected impact
Keyboard users keep their place. Could break: nothing.

## Evaluation
Claim: user - the drawer follows the owner, not stale state
Before: 1 ghost reopen per undo of a last-shot decision (walked)
After: predicted 0
Method: simulation - needs DOM focus and state over time
Result: better
Gate: none
instrument: extract the open-cursor rule into a pure helper (openAfterChange(order, open)) with cases, then wire

title: Gate and idea-dialog Undo show a raw 409 instead of the toast's Cancel-first offer
body:
## Summary
Undoing an accept whose generation job still runs: the toast says 'Cancel it first' and offers Cancel; the Gate's and the idea dialog's Undo print the server's raw error with no action.

## Description
apps/studio/src/board/undo.tsx:31 uses CANCEL_FIRST + CancelJobButton on 409 (outcome.ts:41 isRunningConflict); apps/studio/src/board/shared.tsx:587/:635 and CasesView idea dialog undo render serverError(undo.error) only. Fix: map isRunningConflict to CANCEL_FIRST and render CancelJobButton for the item's job in both places.

## Flow
- accept a design, open its lightbox while the video job runs, press Undo in the Gate
- observed: 'Not undone: <server text>'
- fix: the same words and Cancel as the toast

## Expected impact
One recovery path for one refusal. Could break: nothing.

## Evaluation
Claim: user - the refusal is actionable everywhere
Before: 1 of 3 undo surfaces handles 409
After: predicted 3 of 3
Method: simulation - 409 needs a running job; a pure mapper test would make it gate
Result: better
Gate: none
instrument: outcome.test.ts undoRefusal(e, jobId) -> {message, cancelJobId} shared by the toast, the Gate and the idea dialog
